reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of this when I copy-paste. Handing my CRM and Google Workspace to a company I've never heard of, for 99 a month, isn't something I'd do this week.
objection: I've never heard of FLUGIA; is it going to be around in two years, and what does it really do beyond the ChatGPT I already pay for? 100 credits a month also tells me nothing about how much work I actually get.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own data where the sales co-worker actually keeps my CRM updated and follows up leads without me, plus a reference from a Belgian or Dutch business my size.
